question: What becomes dear to the yoginis through enjoyment, liberation, and great accomplishment?
premises: bhukti mukti mahā siddhiḥ yoginīnāṃ priyo bhavet
the verse links enjoyment liberation and great accomplishment
the result is becoming dear to yoginis
inference: The practitioner who attains these becomes dear to the yoginis.
uncertainties: exact syntactic relation of mahā to siddhiḥ
plain_english: Enjoyment, liberation, and great accomplishment make one dear to the yoginis.
